name: memova
description: Run Memova workflows, set up user-owned knowledge inputs, and manage opt-in Codex conversation sync.

interface.shortDescription: Open Memova setup, tasks, vault diagnosis, and conversation sync.
interface.longDescription: Connect Codex to Memova through OAuth MCP for knowledge-base and automation workflows. Use @memova starter prompts and bundled skills to open a Memova menu, set up or diagnose an iCloud-first user-owned Memova raw-input root, review and run existing automation tasks, and explicitly configure the M4 Codex conversation Collector. Version 1.1.0 uses one-login MCP pairing to issue a separate device-bound Collector credential and supports incremental neutral-archive sync with thread, device, and all-data deletion.
defaultPrompt: Set up private Codex conversation sync.
